body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for original fictional Larch Turbo 1995, a long boxy five-door sleeper station wagon in the post-apocalyptic 2994 salvage world. Reference image is STYLE AND SHEET ORDER ONLY, not vehicle shape. Create a DISTINCT ochre-yellow long-roof wagon with straight upright cargo tailgate, generous rectangular cargo side windows, thin roof rails, blunt front with two narrow horizontally split rectangular lamp units and plain dark grille, full-width low rear lamp band, dark gray bumpers, subtle lower spoiler, modest patch repairs and worn paint. No real brand logos, no text, no badges, no copied grille emblem. Eight views in exactly TWO ROWS of FOUR equal cells: top front, front-right 45deg (nose left), right side (nose left), rear-left45deg (nose right); bottom rear, rear-right45deg (nose left), left side (nose right), front-left45deg (nose right). Consistent body, proportions and styling across views. Orthographic-ish racing sprites, realistic hand-painted textured 3D look. Each sprite fully inside own cell, ample clear gaps. Genuinely transparent background. CRITICAL runtime wheels are added separately: NO wheels, NO tires, NO brake discs; every wheel arch is a completely alpha-transparent open semicircular cutout connected to the transparent space below the car, not a black filled recess. No ground shadow/background. No visible opposing wheels through cutouts. Maintain front/rear wheels cutout positions and proper wheelbase on long wagon. Wide sheet aspect3:1, similar layout to reference.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production dashboard overlay for original fictional Larch Turbo1995, a worn ochre-yellow long-roof 1990s sleeper station wagon in2994 salvage game. Reference1 dashboard is only layout/template and texture style, reference2 is car identity. Create a DISTINCT broad upright 1990s dashboard, charcoal textured padding, faded dark walnut insert across center/passenger area, ochre exposed metal A-pillars at extreme edges, rectangular air vents and mechanical rotary controls. LEFT-HAND DRIVE. Large EMPTY dark instrument recess occupying left quarter/lower-left (approximately x250-800 y540-700 in2000x800 canvas), to receive runtime gauges. No steering wheel, no baked gauges, no needles, no digits, no labels, no logos. No hands, seats or shifter obscuring dashboard. A windshield-shaped completely transparent upper half showing no scenery, no glass tint. Dashboard extends fully across entire lower edge, wide aspect2.5:1, driver-eye view. Slight hand-painted realistic salvage wear and repair screws, NOT extreme ruin. Keep empty cluster opaque dark black with generous room for gauge overlay, no circular holes. No floating objects.
